items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I was just a jazz soloist in the band, and Roger was a marvelous guy to work for.

ctx.x: son of one of the richest men in the world, Otto Kahn, so they would try to get Roger to buy the nightclub or restaurant which Roger refused to do, so that would be the end of our job and I said that being this wealthy was an obstacle in the way of getting work, because I was only with him about six months and we had about three jobs in the six months.

And it was a marvelous band and all the best arrangers in the field were to go on and become composers out in Hollywood and it was beautiful music to play, Of course, it was dance music, and I was just a jazz soloist in the band, and Roger was a marvelous guy to work for.
It was sort of like Isham Jones.
